brands.evidence: Yes, you can use Monzo as your main UK current account for your salary, Direct Debits, and everyday bills.

client_claims.text: Monzo is a fully regulated UK bank, with eligible deposits protected up to £120,000 by the FSCS.
Using Monzo as your main account unlocks higher/unlimited fee-free UK/EEA ATM withdrawals.
client_claims.note: Unlimited if Monzo is main bank.

client_claims.text: Monzo Perks plan includes free cash deposits, while the free tier charges a small fee for cash deposits.
client_claims.note: Facts list Perks at £9 a month but say nothing on cash deposit fees.

client_claims.text: Early Payday: Monzo lets you claim your salary at 4:00 pm one working day early at no extra cost.
Double Payday Draw: salary between £300 and £20,000 entered into a monthly draw where 10 people have take-home pay matched up to £10,000.
Monzo offers 24/7 chat/phone support and has no physical branches.
A full CASS switch takes 7 working days and Monzo supports the Current Account Switch Service.
Monzo historically relies on partner routing for incoming international SWIFT payments rather than a dedicated native IBAN.
